subject: Conformix SOC2 evidence exchange & pen-test handoff
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@conformix.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@conformix.com
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Conformix x Redwood — SOC2 evidence exchange & pen-test handoff

Hi Sergio and Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday — great to meet. Conformix is moving forward with a joint integration where we’ll surface Redwood evidence artifacts inside our control panel and we want to coordinate the SOC2 evidence exchange and the upcoming BlueProbe pen test handoff.

Primary asks to start the intake:
- Can you share the SOC2 evidence inventory (archived logs, policy docs) and a small sample of access logs we can use for verification?
- BlueProbe (cc'd separately) will need a scoping doc and contact for environment/timebox coordination.
- Any preferred transfer method for sensitive artifacts (S3 presigned, secure share, or DocuSign evidence escrow)?

I attached a starter ask list (conformix-soc2-ask-list.xlsx). Claire from BlueProbe will follow up on scheduling.

High level timeline: intake this week, scoping by 10/7, handoff 10/12–10/16. Does that work on your side?

Thanks,
Lena Park
Head of Partner Integrations | Conformix GRC
Lena Park
attachments: [conformix-soc2-ask-list.xlsx]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@conformix.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Claire Johnson <claire.j@blueprobe.io>, ops@blueprobe.io
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Conformix x Redwood — SOC2 evidence exchange & pen-test handoff

Lena — thanks, this looks straightforward. We can meet your timeline. Quick notes/answers: 

- Evidence inventory: attaching a short index and a small log sample for BlueProbe. Priyom is looped for the export and redaction step.
- Transfer: we prefer an S3 presigned + short-lived encryption key for anything system-generated; for legal docs DocuSign or our secure share is fine.
- Scope: BlueProbe should expect a standard external/internal test plus a quick config review of our evidence connector. No scoped access to customer PII.

Proposed next steps:
1) Priyom will publish the log sample to a presigned bucket by 10/4.
2) Claire to send a scoping PDF with exact durations and IP allowlist.
3) Vanessa to confirm retention/least-privilege rules for the exchange.

If that looks good I’ll send a short MPO (mutual action plan) and a DocuSign routing for the non-disclosure and limited-evidence transfer.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: [redwood-access-log-sample.csv]

From: Claire Johnson <claire.j@blueprobe.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@conformix.com>
Cc: ops@blueprobe.io
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: BlueProbe scoping — Redwood/Conformix engagement

Thanks Sergio/Lena — I’m Claire from BlueProbe, taking the scoping lead. Short answers and requests: 

- Timebox: 3 business days of active testing + 1 day reporting (we can compress to 2 days if limited scope).
- IPs: we’ll provide an allowlist and a short VPN jumpbox plan for any internal-only checks.
- Artifacts: please provide a 7-day sample of access logs + a list of endpoints we should exclude from fuzzing.

Attached is our scoping template (blueprobe-pen-test-scoping.pdf). Can Priyom drop the sample logs to the presigned link Serena (ops@blueprobe.io) will post? We prefer minimal retention (48–72 hours) on our side and will delete on confirmation.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Johnson
Senior Engagement Manager | BlueProbe Security
attachments: [blueprobe-pen-test-scoping.pdf]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.j@blueprobe.io>, ops@blueprobe.io
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@conformix.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueProbe scoping — Redwood/Conformix engagement

Claire — uploaded a redacted 7-day access log sample to S3 and created a presigned URL (valid 72h). Short notes on redaction and scope:
- All user IDs are hashed, IPs are truncated to /24 for the sample; timestamps are intact.
- The sample excludes internal admin endpoints: /admin/* and telemetry ingestion endpoints.
- I added a csv manifest for the specific endpoints included.

Presigned link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-sec-presigned/preview-20261006?signature=XXX (expires 72 hours)
Retention policy: Redwood will keep the sample for 7 days internally, BlueProbe to confirm deletion within 72 hours after download.

If you need raw logs for additional correlation we can route through our SOC with redaction approval (will need DocuSign).

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Staff Engineer, Integrations | Redwood Inference
attachments: [redwood-access-log-sample.csv]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@conformix.com>, Claire Johnson <claire.j@blueprobe.io>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueProbe scoping — Redwood/Conformix engagement

Quick compliance constraints from our side: 
- Minimal retention policy required on external tester side: logs must be deleted within 72 hours and blueprobe must provide a deletion confirmation email.
- No test access to production customer data; all samples must be synthetic or redacted as Priyom described.
- We require a simple one-page Addendum to the SOW that covers evidence handling and data deletion timelines.

Sergio — can you route a one-page addendum (I can draft) and the DocuSign for the transfer? Lena — please confirm Conformix is ok with the 72h deletion and the addendum.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
